translation: Flavor pungent and sweet, non-toxic. It mainly warms the center and sends qi downward, makes the uterus of women warm and the yin of men strong. Taken over a long time, it beautifies the complexion and makes one have children. One name is Huichuang [虺床], one name is Siyi [思益], one name is Shengdu [繩毒], one name is Zaoji [棗棘], one name is Qiangmi [牆蘼].
